description_en: Deletes a revoked client certificate or server certificate. Only revoked certificates can be deleted
description_zh: 删除已吊销的客户端证书或服务端证书
name: DeleteClientCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client or server-side certificate to delete. The certificate must be in the REVOKE state.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html to query the unique identifiers and current states of all client and server-side certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。证书的当前状态必须是REVOKE。



您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的唯一识别码和当前状态
parameters.name: identifier
